$comment: Every name of the bit BlazorUI packages' public API removed or renamed since 10.5.0 that an app may still use, with what to write instead. Read by Bit.BlazorUI.Analyzers (BITBC001 for a member, BITBC002 for a type or component) and by the MCP server's GetBitBlazorUIBreakingChanges. kind 'member': a parameter or property named 'name' of the types in 'on' (and of their subclasses); on a component it is matched in markup too. kind 'type': a type named 'name'; 'component': true matches its tag in .razor files too. 'use': what replaces it, a name of the current API (empty when nothing does). 'hint': the fix, one or more sentences. 'since': the version it is gone in. A rename or removal in the public API adds its entry here in the same change as its BreakingChanges.md entry; BitBreakingChangesDataTests checks every entry against the compiled packages.
